title: Bu Nasıl Ada?
author: Doğan Akdoğan
description: Ada is the child of a family passionately devoted to the seas and embarks on an unforgettable journey to the Mariana Trench with her parents. This journey takes her to a mysterious island accessible only through an underwater tunnel, where extinct animals secretly live. On the island, she meets moas, mammoths, dodo birds, and other animals, discovering the importance of nature, diversity, and conservation. The story, with its adventure-filled narrative, connects children with a love for nature, empathy, and a sense of responsibility.
